name: 11378 · Maspeth, NY
findings: ZIP 11378 (Maspeth) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11378 (Maspeth) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
81% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11378 (Maspeth) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 25% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 89% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
